description: courtscheduler.move-hearing-to-past-date — books a hearing onto past session(s), both jurisdictions. Past dates only: startTime/endTime on or after today (UTC) is a 422 FUTURE_DATE_NOT_ALLOWED. Per sitting day, the non-draft session in courtRoomId whose window contains the startTime time-of-day (any court_session, weekends included, no room fallback); the submitted window is the booked duration (a full court day per day for a MAGISTRATES multi-day span) and the submitted start/end are returned on each session. A CROWN multi-day move is not supported: 422 MULTI_DAY_NOT_ALLOWED. Any move with no matching past session is a 422 NO_SESSION_FOUND.
